title: Stale memories: prompt to confirm or forget, and doctor flags CLAUDE.md duplicates
body: Prime marks a memory old and then shows it forever. Nothing prompts an agent to confirm, refresh or forget it. Two candidates: prime asks the agent to confirm or forget anything marked old; doctor reports a memory whose text also appears in CLAUDE.md, since both land in every session's context.
close_reason: prime prompts on marked memories, doctor flags CLAUDE.md duplicates; committed as 'Tell the agent what to do with an old memory, and flag one that repeats CLAUDE.md'
